svg.title: Agent tools share one memory through BrigadeStack
svg.desc: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, ChatGPT dots and Claude Duet each connect to BrigadeStack shared memory. From it they share memory, check records, MCP servers and skills.
